description: This file defines the class RetrieveStatisticsResponse, which represents the response to a RetrieveStatistics command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the statistics data, and serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: RetrieveStatisticsResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response containing statistics JSON data for a RetrieveStatistics command.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance with provided statistics JSON and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a response instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns the JSON object of statistics.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity (statistics JSON) from a JsonValue.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the statistics JSON in the format suited for a given schema version.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the statistics payload to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check for the response object.
